shown.message:
I redrew Figs 5 and 7 and the appendix floor-b figure on the new results (`ea35f63`) and pushed them to `paper-repo` `dev` as `b6dbcb3`. I regenerated `caption_ranges.json` in the same commit.

- **Fig 5:** it now draws the ACS Employment MLP floors a, b and c as open markers (K = 6). German MLP retraining floors stay n/a.
- **Fig 7 and the appendix floor-b figure:** each gains the four ACS Employment MLP background rows.
- **Caption ranges:** counts changed in the regenerated file, so the captions and text need checking against it. Fig 5 floor c is now 19 cells, and floors a and b are 20. Fig 7 has 7 cells and the appendix floor-b figure has 12. `paper-repo` already pushed text on these floors (`2c61808`); I haven't compared it with the new ranges.
- **Other figures and tables:** the rebuild left every other plotted csv unchanged. Only `fig5`, `fig7` and `figA_floor_b_sampled` differ.
- **Still open:** German MLP floor b by B hasn't been delivered by `experiment-repo`, so `figtab-repo`#4 stays open. Fig 7 will take it as a new row when it lands.

I commented on `figtab-repo`#4 and #2 with the same status.
